decisions.reason: Strong external adoption with the UK Home Office and many APIS schemes has resolved uncertainty favourably, so the product is retained as a proven service.
Cyber awareness training remains close to existing services and cheap to keep while its prospects are still uncertain.
Another year without traction and persistent regulatory and reputational uncertainty signal that the profiling method is unlikely to realise value, so the option is abandoned.
The verification web platform fits established services and has a dedicated page, so it is kept open while results continue to develop.
